review_basis: Human visual review of rendered vector PDF sheets MI702-MI732. The expected titles are the horizontal detail captions visible on the drawing field, not rotated title-block descriptions. Six schematic/SOO pairs are authored on consecutive sheets, one pair is authored on MI730, MI731 is intentionally unbound because its prose has no extracted SOO heading, and MI732 is intentionally unbound because its authored note sends control sequences to fire-protection sheets outside this mechanical PDF. Expectations describe source truth, not prior engine output.
